mechanisms.behavior: PDF/folio41 assembly500-7216-13 has three target bodies545-6305-00, three compression springs266-5089-00, three reset springs266-5003-02, one lift bracket535-9996-03, one plunger530-5757-00, one25-1240 coil090-5034-ND and one three-target opto PCB520-5252-13. Driver9 names bank reset; switch43/44/45 are left/center/right drop optos. The common lift/reset actuator and three separately sensed target positions are explicit. The drawing shows independently falling targets above the common reset frame. Their physical default raised state is a reset result, not a boot-state assertion. Unresolved: Initial/park state, exact travel, coil pulse timing, opto rest contact construction, when reset is commanded, jam/missed-reset retry and target return timing are unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Three drop targets and shared reset

mechanisms.behavior: Two physical pop actuators share8-DR-6/output7; separate left/right sensors37/39. Bottom pop uses distinct output8/sensor38. No electrical polarity or movement timing inferred.

mechanisms.behavior: Own-title top-assembly inventory lists one left511-2781-00 and one right511-5096-01-L8 gate. Driver10 labels Left/Right Control Gates on one public output.
